data.body: IMPLEMENTED + committed 2a5f174f9b on story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/0f17-prebump-sync off main. DD1: _phase_prebump_feature_sync(pinned_sha) wired into _phase_staged_intermediate before the bump; pin = staged ref's tip (TOCTOU-free). DD2: idempotent skip when origin/<branch> exists (never force-push under in-flight review) + abort/hard-restore HEAD on code conflict + pre-image patch + PREBUMP_SYNC_CONFLICT marker + fail-closed on empty/unfetchable pin. DD3: ci-pr-only (direct mode _phase_sync already merges origin/main pre-bump, untouched) + marketplace guard test (bump-version.sh never writes marketplace.json). DD4: no-op (0cd7 KEEP already ticket-store-only). Tests: test-merge-to-main-prebump-sync.sh 5/5 (clean-rebase/idempotent-skip/already-based/conflict-abort-restore/empty-pin) + test-bump-version-marketplace-guard.sh 1/1; existing merge-to-main fn tests green; shellcheck clean. NOTE the merge self-exercises the new code (branch is current -> already-based no-op path).
